sources.t: Social tariffs: Cheaper broadband and phone packages
sources.f: Updated 22 June 2026; Ofcom lists lower-cost broadband and phone packages for eligible benefit recipients.
sources.g: Tariff eligibility and advertised speeds do not establish current service availability at a parcel.

sources.t: 3G and 2G switch-off: expectations of mobile providers
sources.f: Updated 29 May 2026; Ofcom records completed UK 3G switch-offs and expectations for future 2G closures.
sources.g: Mobile-network transition guidance is not fixed-broadband parcel evidence.

sources.t: 2G and 3G switch-off advice for IoT suppliers
sources.f: Updated 19 June 2026; Ofcom advises IoT and third-party device suppliers on the transition from older mobile networks.
sources.g: Industry transition advice does not prove connectivity or orderability at an address.

sources.t: Switching off the UK's 2G and 3G networks: customer advice
sources.f: Updated 29 May 2026; Ofcom explains that UK 3G networks are switched off and 2G closures will occur over coming years.
sources.g: National mobile transition status is not exact fixed-internet service evidence.

sources.t: Mobile connectivity you can count on
sources.f: Published 3 June 2026; Ofcom opened stakeholder engagement on reliable mobile connectivity and service quality.
sources.g: A discussion paper and supporting research do not establish parcel-level service.

sources.t: Broadband and landline faults and problems
sources.f: Updated 8 April 2026; Ofcom provides fault diagnosis, reporting and priority-repair guidance.
sources.g: Fault-handling guidance does not prove network coverage or current availability.

sources.t: Research on cutting phone and internet bills
sources.f: Updated 30 June 2026; Ofcom summarises pricing and consumer-engagement research and switching behaviour.
sources.g: Market research and potential savings do not establish exact-address connectivity.

sources.t: Comparing customer service report
sources.f: Updated 25 May 2026; Ofcom compares provider customer-service metrics and records a corrected EE data submission.
sources.g: Provider service-quality metrics are not parcel availability evidence.

sources.t: Problem with your phone provider
sources.f: Updated 8 April 2026; Ofcom explains provider complaints and escalation routes.
sources.g: Complaint procedures do not establish service at a premises.

sources.t: Q3 2025 telecoms and pay-TV complaints
sources.f: Updated 8 May 2026; Ofcom publishes provider complaint rates for Q3 2025.
sources.g: Historic complaint rates are not current coverage or orderability evidence.

sources.t: Making a complaint and using ADR schemes
sources.f: Updated 20 July 2026; Ofcom explains approved alternative dispute resolution routes.
sources.g: Consumer-redress procedures do not prove parcel connectivity.

sources.t: Mobile phone service faults and problems
sources.f: Updated 8 April 2026; Ofcom explains how to identify and report mobile faults.
sources.g: Fault guidance and predicted mobile coverage are not fixed-broadband parcel truth.

sources.t: Connected Nations planned network deployment framework
sources.f: Ofcom explains the statutory purpose and scope of planned very-high-capacity network reporting.
sources.g: Operator plans for future deployment are not current exact-address service.

sources.t: Right to request a decent broadband service
sources.f: Updated 19 June 2026; Ofcom explains the broadband universal service right and eligibility process.
sources.g: A legal right to request service does not prove an existing orderable connection.

sources.t: Launch of the 2026 wholesale telecoms review
sources.f: Ofcom describes the review of wholesale telecoms regulation applying from April 2026 to March 2031.
sources.g: Historic national coverage figures and regulatory review scope are not parcel truth.

sources.t: BDUK delivery performance annual bulletin April 2025 to March 2026
sources.f: Official annual statistics bulletin covers BDUK delivery performance for financial year 2025/26.
sources.g: Annual subsidised-delivery statistics are aggregate and do not prove current exact-premises availability.

sources.t: BDUK annual delivery performance quality and methodology information
sources.f: Official QMI documents compilation, revisions and interpretation of the 2025/26 annual statistics.
sources.g: Methodology supports interpretation but does not establish service at an individual UPRN.

sources.t: BDUK annual delivery performance pre-release access list
sources.f: Official pre-release access record accompanies the annual 2025/26 BDUK statistics publication.
sources.g: Publication-governance evidence is not broadband availability evidence.

sources.t: BDUK delivery performance April to June 2026 announcement
sources.f: Official statistics announcement schedules breakdowns of premises receiving BDUK-subsidised coverage in April-June 2026.
sources.g: An announcement and future aggregate release do not prove parcel service.

sources.t: BDUK delivery performance April to September 2025 bulletin
sources.f: Official quarterly bulletin covers subsidised delivery from April to September 2025 and revisions to earlier time series.
sources.g: Historic aggregate delivery statistics are not current exact-address orderability evidence.
